sections.title: 3 Tool Use Agent
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   User → LLM → Decides Tool → Executes → Returns Answer  │
│                                                          │
│   Focus: Direct tool binding via function calling API    │
│   Unlike ReAct: No explicit Thought/Observation text     │
│   Uses: OpenAI function_calling / tools parameter        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
**Core Idea:** The LLM natively selects and calls tools via structured JSON (OpenAI `tools` API). No prompt engineering for format — the model handles it natively.

sections.title: 7 Self-Ask Agent
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                          │
│  Complex Question: "Who was the president when the       │
│                     Eiffel Tower was built?"             │
│       │                                                  │
│       ▼                                                  │
│  Follow-up Q1: "When was the Eiffel Tower built?"        │
│       │  Answer: 1889                                    │
│       ▼                                                  │
│  Follow-up Q2: "Who was the US president in 1889?"       │
│       │  Answer: Grover Cleveland                        │
│       ▼                                                  │
│  Final Answer: "Grover Cleveland"                        │
│                                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
**Core Idea:** The LLM **decomposes a complex question** into smaller follow-up questions, answers each one, and builds up to the final answer.

sections.title: 8 Tree of Thoughts (ToT Agent)
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                          │
│                     Problem                              │
│                        │                                │
│            ┌───────────┼───────────┐                    │
│            ▼           ▼           ▼                    │
│        Thought A   Thought B   Thought C  ← Branch      │
│           │            │           │                    │
│        ┌──┴──┐      ┌──┴──┐    ┌───┴───┐               │
│        A1   A2      B1   B2    C1     C2  ← Expand      │
│         │               │        │                      │
│        ❌              ✅        ❌    ← Evaluate        │
│                         │                               │
│                    Best Path  → Final Answer             │
│                                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
**Core Idea:** Explores **multiple reasoning branches** like a tree. Each node is a "thought". A evaluator scores each branch and prunes poor paths — best for hard reasoning/puzzle tasks.

sections.title: 9 LLM Compiler Agent
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                          │
│  User Task                                               │
│       │                                                  │
│       ▼                                                  │
│  ┌──────────┐   Creates a DAG of tasks                  │
│  │ PLANNER  │──►  Task 1 → Task 3                       │
│  └──────────┘    Task 2 → Task 3  (parallel!)           │
│                       │                                  │
│                       ▼                                  │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────┐                      │
│  │         TASK FETCHER           │                      │
│  │  Runs Task 1 ║ Task 2          │  ← PARALLEL          │
│  │  (simultaneously)              │                      │
│  └────────────────────────────────┘                      │
│                       │                                  │
│                       ▼                                  │
│  ┌──────────┐   Joins all results                        │
│  │  JOINER  │──► Final Answer                            │
│  └──────────┘                                            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
**Core Idea:** Like a compiler optimizes code — the agent creates a **DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph)** of tasks and runs **independent tasks in parallel** for maximum efficiency.

sections.title: LATS Agent (Language Agent Tree Search)
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Combines: ReAct + Tree of Thoughts + Self-Reflection   │
│                                                          │
│       Problem                                            │
│          │                                               │
│    ┌─────┴──────┐                                        │
│    ▼            ▼                                        │
│  Path A       Path B  ← Multiple ReAct trajectories     │
│  T→A→O        T→A→O                                     │
│    │            │                                        │
│  Score        Score  ← Reflection scores each path      │
│   0.4          0.9                                       │
│                │                                         │
│           Best Path                                      │
│                │                                         │
│          Final Answer                                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
**Core Idea:** Runs **multiple ReAct trajectories** as a tree, scores each with a reflector, and selects the best path — the most powerful but expensive pattern.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: A **Tool Use Agent** uses OpenAI's native **`tools` API** (function calling) to let the LLM **directly select and invoke tools** via structured JSON — no prompt engineering needed for format, unlike ReAct.

sections.title: ReAct vs Tool Use — Key Difference
Full Implementation
Message Flow Diagram
sections.body:
```
messages = [
  { role: "system",    content: "You are a helpful assistant..." },
  { role: "user",      content: "Convert 100 km to miles"        },
        ↓  LLM responds with tool_calls
  { role: "assistant", tool_calls: [{ name: "unit_converter",
                                      args: {value:100,...} }]   },
        ↓  We execute the tool and append result
  { role: "tool",      tool_call_id: "xxx",
                       content: "100 km = 62.1371 miles"         },
        ↓  LLM sees result and gives final answer
  { role: "assistant", content: "100 km equals 62.14 miles."     }
]
```

sections.title: Key Concepts Summary
sections.body:
| Concept | Detail |
|---|---|
| `tools=` | Pass tool schemas to Azure OpenAI |
| `tool_choice="auto"` | LLM decides when to use tools |
| `finish_reason="tool_calls"` | LLM wants to call a tool |
| `finish_reason="stop"` | LLM has final answer |
| `role="tool"` | How you return tool results |
| **Parallel tool calls** | LLM can call multiple tools in one step ✅ |

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: A **Plan & Execute Agent** separates **planning** (what steps to take) from **execution** (actually doing each step). A **Planner LLM** creates a structured step-by-step plan, then an **Executor** runs each step using tools — making it ideal for complex, long-horizon tasks.

sections.title: Comparison with Previous Patterns
sections.body:
```
ReAct Agent:              Tool Use Agent:          Plan & Execute:
──────────────────        ─────────────────        ──────────────────────
Think → Act → Observe     LLM picks tool           PLAN all steps first
(one step at a time)      (one step at a time)     THEN execute all steps
                                                   
✅ Flexible               ✅ Structured JSON        ✅ Best for long tasks
❌ No upfront plan        ❌ No upfront plan         ✅ Clear step tracking
❌ Can lose track         ❌ Can lose track          ✅ Easy to debug/audit
```
